dataset_name: TemanKRL KRL Jabodetabek MVP Master Data
verified_by: Product owner, after physical-device field testing (2026-11-17, DECISIONS D-066)
source_file: User-uploaded Pasted markdown.md containing a JSON response with 112 station records
source_data_status: Coordinates and station codes populated from supplied API response; accepted for production by the product owner after field testing. No independent official cross-check was performed.

changes.summary: First production release: marked verified by the product owner (DECISIONS D-066). Station, line and pattern records are identical to 0.2.1-draft.

Added Stasiun Jatake (KCI-JTK, code JTK) on Lin Rangkasbitung between Cicayur and Parung Panjang in KCI-SP-R-OUT (sequence 11) and KCI-SP-R-BACK (sequence 10); later stops in both patterns shift by one. No other station record changed.

limitations: The uploaded API response is treated as the supplied source snapshot; its live freshness and upstream provenance are not independently established here.
Coordinates are present in the source response but still need independent cross-check before GPS production use.
The route map provides line topology and order, not train-by-train stopping patterns.
Six patterns are full-stop directional baselines only. Actual express/short-turn/operational stop variants are not yet established.
Review source license and attribution obligations before bundling or redistributing the data.

Jatake (JTK) is owner-supplied: coordinates cross-checked against OpenStreetMap (about 30 m apart), station code JTK not confirmed by an official source, stopping assumed as in the full-stop baseline (opened 28 Jan 2026 on Tanah Abang - Rangkasbitung).
